question: Six-variant UIT-ADrone matrix (45 epoch) using the same variant IDs/naming as the DA matrix; dual-GPU dynamic scheduling

architecture.description: 12-block student (4 reconstructions), 4 teacher taps [5,7,9,11], OCBE h512

data_protocol.aggregation: concat all test frames then one ROC AUC and EER
data_protocol.official_overlap: historical UIT protocol retains train frames inside test full videos; no deduplication

acceptance.compare: all six variants use identical UIT loading, seed42, 45 epoch budget, evaluation and checkpoint cadence

acceptance.variant_guard: config variant_id -> builder -> teacher taps -> expected parameter count must match before training

runtime_resources.policy: dynamic per-GPU queue; next variant starts when a GPU frees; pin by UUID
